tha-ap392:1.1: Pubbakammapiloti.] Anota*ttasarāsanne ramaṇīye silā*tale / nānāratanapajjote nānāgandhavanantare // //
tha-ap392:2.1: Mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena pareto lokanāyako / āsīno vyākari tattha pubbakammāni attano: // //
tha-ap392:3.1: ‘Suṇotha bhikkhavo mayham yaṃ kammaṃ pakatam mayā / *pilotiyassa kammassa buddhatthe* pi vipaccati. // //
tha-ap392:4.1: Munāli nām' ahaṃ dhutto pubbe aññāsu jātisu / paccekabuddhaṃ Surabhim abbhācikkhim adūsakaṃ. // //
tha-ap392:5.1: Tena kammavipākena niraye saṃsariṃ ciraṃ / bahū vassasahassāni dukkhaṃ vedesiṃ vedanaṃ. // //
tha-ap392:6.1: Tena kammāvasesena idha pa*cchimake bhave / abbhakkhā*naṃ mayā laddhaṃ Sundarīkāya kāraṇā. // //
tha-ap392:7.1: Sabbābhibhussa Buddhassa Nando nām' āsi sāvako / tam abbhakkhāya niraye ciraṃ saṃsaritam mayā. // //
tha-ap392:8.1: Dasavassasahassāni niraye saṃsariṃ ciraṃ / manussabhāvaṃ laddhāham abbhakkhānaṃ bahuṃ labhiṃ. // //
tha-ap392:9.1: Tena kammā*vasesena Ciñca* mānavikā mamaṃ / abbhakkhāsi abhūtena janakāyassa aggato. // //
tha-ap392:10.1: Brāhmaṇo sutavā āsim ahaṃ sakkatapūjito / mahāvane pañcasate *mante* vācemi māṇave. // //
tha-ap392:11.1: Tatthāgato Isigaṇo pañcābhiññāmahi*ddhiko* / tañ cāham ā*gataṃ disvā abbhācikkhim adūsakaṃ. // //
tha-ap392:12.1: Tato 'ham avacaṃ sisse: kāmabhogī ayaṃ isi / mayhaṃ vibhāsamānassa anumodiṃsu māṇavā. // //
tha-ap392:13.1: Tato māṇavakā sabbe bhikkhamānā kulākule / mahājanassa ahaṃsu: *kāma*bhogī ayaṃ isi. // //
tha-ap392:14.1: Tena kammavipākena pañcabhikkhusatā ime / abbhakkhānaṃ labhuṃ sabbe Sundarīkāya kāraṇā. // //
tha-ap392:15.1: Dvemātā-bhātaro pubbe dhanahetu haniṃ ahaṃ / pakkhipiṃ giriduggesu silāya ca apiṃsayiṃ. // //
tha-ap392:16.1: Tena kammavipākena Devadatto silaṃ khipi / aṅguṭṭhaṃ piṃsayī pāde mama pāsānasakkharā. // //
tha-ap392:17.1: Pure 'haṃ dārako hutvā kīḷamāno mahāpathe / paccekabuddhaṃ disvāna magge sakalikaṃ dahiṃ. // //
tha-ap392:18.1: Tena kammavipākena idha pacchimake bhave / vadhatthaṃ maṃ Devadatto abhimāre payojayi. // //
tha-ap392:19.1: Hatthāroho pure āsiṃ paccekamunim uttamaṃ / piṇḍāya vicarantaṃ *tam* āsādesiṃ gajen' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap392:20.1: Tena kammavipākena bhanto Nāḷāgirī gajo / Giribbaje puravare dāruṇo mam upāgamī. // //
tha-ap392:21.1: Rājāhaṃ patthivo āsiṃ sattiyā purisaṃ haniṃ / tena kammavipākena niraye paccasiṃ bhusaṃ. // //
tha-ap392:22.1: Kammuṇo tassa sesena c'ādiṇṇaṃ sakalaṃ mama / pāde chaviṃ pakopesi na hi kammaṃ panassati. // //
tha-ap392:23.1: Ahaṃ kevaṭṭagāmasmim ahuṃ kevaṭṭadārako / macchake ghātite disvā janayiṃ somanassakaṃ. // //
tha-ap392:24.1: Tena kammavipākena sīsadukkham ahu mama / Sakkesu haññamānesu yadā hani Viḍuḍabho. // //
tha-ap392:25.1: Phussassāhaṃ pāvacane sāvake paribhāsayiṃ / yavaṃ khādatha bhuñjatha mā ca bhuñjatha sāliyo. // //
tha-ap392:26.1: Tena kammavipākena temāsaṃ khāditaṃ yavaṃ / nimantito brāhmaṇena verajjāyaṃ vasiṃ tadā. // //
tha-ap392:27.1: Nibbuddhe vattamānamhi Mallaputtaṃ nisedhayiṃ / tena kammavipākena piṭṭhidukkham ahu mama. // //
tha-ap392:28.1: Tikicchako aham āsiṃ seṭṭhiputtaṃ virecayiṃ / tena kammavipākena hoti pakkhandikā mama. // //
tha-ap392:29.1: Avacāhaṃ Jotipālo sugataṃ Kassapaṃ tadā: / kuto nu bodhi muṇḍassa bodhi paramadullabhā? // //
tha-ap392:30.1: Tena kammavipākena ācariṃ dukkaraṃ bahuṃ / chabbassān' Uruvelāyaṃ tato bodhim apāpuṇiṃ. // //
tha-ap392:31.1: Nāhaṃ etena maggena pāpuṇiṃ bodhim uttamaṃ / kummaggena gavesissaṃ pubbakammena kārito. // //
tha-ap392:32.1: Puññapāpaparikhīṇo sabbasantāpavajjito / asoko anupāyāso nibbāyissam anāsavo.' // //
tha-ap392:33.1: Evaṃ jino viyākāsi bhikkhusaṅghassa aggato // // sabbābhiññābalappatto Anotatte mahāsare ti.
tha-ap392:34.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ bhagavā attano pubbacaritaṃ Pubbakammapiloti nāma Buddhāpadānaṃ dhammapariyāyam abhāsi. Pubbakammapiloti
tha-ap392:38.1: Avaṇṭaṃ Labujañ c' eva Udumbara Pilakkhu ca Phāru-Vallī ca Kadalī Panasa-Koṭivīsako.
tha-ap392:39.1: Pubbakammapiloti ca apadānaṃ mahesino gāthāyo ekanavuti gaṇitāyo vibhāvihī.
